'''Efridge Engel''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 FreedomCon Last Man Standing]] on 15 November 2001, according to Scott Lingrell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3112">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-21-freedomcond3112/ freedomcon], DeckTech (Scott "CRingwell" Lingrell, 21 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-21-freedomcond3112/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
